# Test fixtures

Binary sample files used by the parser tests. They are redistributed from MIT licensed projects:

- `*.vents_c`, `*.vpk`, `golden/*.txt` — from [ValveResourceFormat](https://github.com/ValveResourceFormat/ValveResourceFormat) `Tests/Files`
  (the `golden` text dumps are Source 2 Viewer's reference output for the same files).
- `*.vmap` — from [Datamodel.NET](https://github.com/ValveResourceFormat/Datamodel.NET) `Tests/Resources`.

None of them contain Zombie Escape items; the UI sample map (`src/model/demo.ts`) is hand written.
